name: Glitchcore
summary: Fast, crowded edits with split colour channels, repeated frames, datamosh, bright flash and old web clutter. It grew with the digicore music scene on SoundCloud, Discord and short-video apps.

philosophy.core_thesis: Overload the signal: show the fault, the repeat and the flash until the error becomes the style.
design_principles: Split the colour channels by 4px to 12px in opposite directions on all key images.
Cut the edit every 4 to 12 frames at 30 fps and repeat the same frame 2 to 4 times.
Use hot colours: acid green (#39FF14), magenta (#FF00AA) and cyan (#00E5FF) on black.
Fill the frame with 5 or more layers: text, stars, cursors, stickers and old web icons.
Set display text at 48px to 120px in a bold face, with a 3px stroke in a second colour.
Add scan lines of 2px at 12% opacity and noise at 8%.
Add a flash warning for any flicker above 3 flashes in 1s.

layout.grid_mechanics: No stable grid; layers overlap at random offsets of 8px to 80px, with 4 to 8 layers in each frame.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 0% to 10% of the frame stays empty; the spacing scale is 2, 4, 8 and 16px.
layout.alignment_rules: Elements are placed off axis, with tilts of -15° to 15° and cropped edges.
layout.container_geometry: Hard rectangles with a 0px radius, window frames, stickers and torn bands of 4px to 40px.

font_pairings.note: A glitch display face with a mono text face.
A bitmap pair for an old-web look.
A heavy condensed face with a mono face for small text.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Set display text with a 3px stroke or a split-colour shadow.
Repeat key words 2 to 3 times at different sizes.

color.palette_structure: Black with 3 hot colours at full strength, and white for flash.
color.contrast_rules: Text on signal black holds at least 12:1; hot colours carry strokes and splits, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat black with colour layers; scan lines of 2px at 12%; noise of 8%; datamosh bands.
color.light_and_shadow: A split-colour offset shadow of 4px in magenta and cyan; bursts of white flash for 1 to 2 frames.

materiality.surface_simulation: A broken video signal, a compressed screen recording and old CRT glow.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px line in acid green on windows; torn band edges with no line.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; a 4px offset shadow in a second colour; layers stack by overlap.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Bitmap icons at 24px: cursors, stars, hearts, warning signs and close buttons, with a 1px dark edge.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Looped anime or game frames, old web stickers, stars and cursors, with datamosh and colour splits.

motion.transition_physics: Jump cuts every 4 to 12 frames; bursts of glitch of 2 to 6 frames; text jitters by 2px to 6px at 12 fps.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover splits the colour channels by 6px for 120ms; the active state cuts to a negative image for 2 frames.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels overloaded, excited and a little anxious, in a fast, playful way.

avoid_when: The audience has photosensitive epilepsy and no safe option exists.
The page needs calm, fast reading.
The brand is formal, medical or financial.

modifiers.how: Slow the cuts to 1.2s, replace hot colours with pastels and lower the noise.
Use clean chrome and pastel gradients, and keep the speed.
Replace the stars with swirls and add chrome type in a violet ground.

pack.why: Pixel icons match the bitmap stickers and old window frames of a glitch edit.

ground.why: Glitchcore shows a broken screen, so the ground is a scan-line field with noise.
